result.topic_en: Continuation of a case analysis in the theory of biquadratic residues (Gaussian integers): it tabulates the complexes Θ, Θ', Θ'', Θ''' with associated signs ε, then treats case 3° (y and X integers) via nearest integers, deriving t+ui and the sign ε according to the signs of x° and Y°.

items.english: ε = −1 if α is positive, x° positive, Y° positive, t+u even, etc.
Thus for every θ'' ε = −1, and for every θ''' ε = +1, insofar as θ'' is divisible by 1+i and α is positive.
